scope: Legacy bridge operations only. features.toml lists the user-visible behaviours, the Dolphin baseline and GNOME integration.

archiveExtract.note: Extraction into a new folder is ported to ox-core and tested: member checks and limits before anything is written, the write guard, private staging published without replacing anything, rollback on damaged data, failed writes and cancellation, and no archive permissions. The native Extract dialog and transfer panel are not wired yet.

archiveInspect.note: The preflight is ported to ox-core and tested: every member is checked with the extraction rules and summarised without writing anything, on a worker thread. The native Extract dialog is not wired yet.

archiveList.note: Listing is ported to ox-core and tested from the central directory alone: unsafe names, links and special files hidden and counted, the 32 MiB directory and 100,000 member limits, and archives on shares read through seekable GIO streams. The native Compressed folder dialog is not wired yet.

archiveOpenMember.note: Opening one document, image or media member as a read-only copy in a private runtime folder is ported to ox-core and tested, with the type, encryption, size and ratio refusals. Opening the copy with its default application from the native UI is not wired yet.

cancel.note: Core cancellation is regression-tested: the transfer engine stops mid-copy and removes its partial stage, a replacement cancelled after the old item is moved aside still finishes so the name is never lost, a local delete cancelled during its preflight keeps the file, GIO copy, move and delete refuse an already-cancelled token, and a listing stops after a batch. Native: Cancel on the transfer panel cancels the running operation, and the panel reads "Cancelling…".

chrome.note: Legacy WebKit transport mechanism. Native toolkit replacement still needs equivalent interaction/lifecycle verification; a deleted bridge is not proof of feature parity.

clipboardConsume.note: Validated GNOME/KDE/custom formats and cut identity tested. Native: A move-paste removes the moved items from the same cut and clears the clipboard once nothing is left.

clipboardGet.note: Validated GNOME/KDE/custom formats and cut identity tested. Native: The window reads the display clipboard asynchronously in format order, again when it changes and when the window becomes active; plain text is no file list.

clipboardSet.note: Validated GNOME/KDE/custom formats and cut identity tested. Native: Cut and Copy claim the display clipboard with all four formats.

clipboardText.note: Native: Copy path (its button, its menu item and Ctrl+Shift+C or Ctrl+Alt+C) puts the display path on the display clipboard as text with gdk::Clipboard::set_text, which cannot fail, so the Python fallback dialog has no trigger. The copy buttons of Properties and the mount setup are proven with their own features.

create.note: ox_core::ops::create_item ports create_item in desktop/gio_backend.py and the checks of the create branch of dispatch: name validation, the refusal inside an SMB server listing, the snapshot write guard, and an exclusive make_directory or create that never overwrites. Native: The New folder dialog runs it: a refused name stays in the dialog, the new folder is selected and Undo removes it.

createTemplate.note: ox_core::ops::create_from_template ports create_from_template in desktop/file_services.py with the OPS-048 rules: the template must be in a fresh list, it is opened without following links or blocking and checked on the descriptor, read in bounded, cancellable blocks, staged in a private file that is published without overwriting and deleted when it is not published. Native: Create in the New from template dialog runs it; the new file is selected.

Native: F2 runs it on the name edited in place (or in the Rename dialog when the item is not on screen) with the base name selected; the renamed item stays selected and Undo and Redo walk the rename.

tabTransferReady.note: ox_core::ops::TabTransfers::acknowledge ports ready in desktop/tab_transfers.py: only an acceptance from the claiming window, while both windows are ready, commits the move; anything else keeps the source tab. Filtering the tab state belongs to the native tab-state type, and the native windows do not move tabs yet.

templates.note: ox_core::ops::list_templates ports PRESETS and list_templates in desktop/file_services.py: the six starters, then at most 100 visible regular files of at most 16 MiB from the Templates folder, listed without following links and without .desktop files. Native: The New file and New from template dialog lists the templates when it opens.

transferConflicts.note: ox_core::ops::find_conflicts answers the paste-conflict query of desktop/winspace.py: 1 to 100,000 item URIs, a destination that must be a folder ("Open a destination folder before pasting.") and the items whose names are taken there, hidden items and dangling links included. A cancelled check is reported as cancelled, never as no conflicts. Native: Paste checks the destination with it and asks about taken names (Skip, Keep both, Replace, Apply to all).

trashSupport.note: ox_core::ops::trash_support asks access::can-trash as trash_support in desktop/gio_backend.py does, and is tested on a local folder, a folder GIO reports without a Trash, and a share that is not mounted, which reaches the caller as not-mounted so it can mount and ask again. ox_core::ops::plan_delete applies the per-folder decision of app.js. Native: The window asks each folder it shows once and labels Delete from the answer; each Delete decides every item by its own folder with plan_delete.
